claim: The phone's Today screen (GET /mobile/feed and GET /mobile/today-pulse) serves the house's money to owners and managers only (ADR 0253, Answered 2026-10-01 round 2, the founder: 'Close it to staff (Recommended)'), with one ruled exception: staff keep draft_approval cards for a drafted vendor letter, whose first 110 characters are the subtitle and whose full text is draftContent, though it may name a price (mobile.service.ts:244-266; ADR 0253 round 9, the founder: 'Keep them (Recommended)'). Notification titles are not gated. In both GET /mobile/feed and GET /mobile/today-pulse, money is exactly seesHouseMoney(req.user.role), which is roleSatisfies(role, 'manager') from procurement/order-approval-gate.ts, so null, an absent role, staff and any unknown string get the staff view; the controller hands req.user.role (the role in the token's house, re-read per request, ADR 0162) to both reads. For anyone else the feed builds no order-approval card, takes `amount` off every card and leaves counts.orderApprovals out; a card built from a notification gets the notification's message as its subtitle only for a type on MONEY_FREE_NOTIFICATION_TYPES whose metadata is not a manager's own-wage notice (isOwnWageNotice, reading the writer's own OWN_WAGE_ACTION), else the card's neutral line, and its meta cut to NON_MONEY_META_KEYS; the pulse makes no Toast sales read and leaves revenueToday, checksToday, revenueLastWeek and deltaPct out. Neither list names a type or key a writer census (2026-10-01) found carrying money. Fix round 2 (the founder, 2026-10-01: 'Give wages its own type (Recommended)'): the own-wage notice is stored as team_member_own_wage_set (type and notification_type, its metadata still naming the action), the web inbox files it under System, `system` is back on the list, and the gateway's literal `type: system` writers are exactly the eight re-read that day (passkeys 1, access-audit 2, away-release 1, notes 1, schedule 2, team.controller 1); sendSystemAlert stores system_alert. authority_grant_issued and authority_grant_reapproved stay off the list: the row names no grantee, so 'Show their own limit (Recommended)' is not built. Owner and manager output is unchanged. Behaviour: mobile/mobile-feed-money-for-staff.spec.ts. This verify pins the shape, fails on 4bd11a00e, 6a714f2a4 and b02d931cd, and kills 41 of 41 source mutations, including `const money = true`, `role !== "staff"` in either read, the wage notice back on `system`, a new `system` writer, and the guard removed, inverted or reading the type.
